grades: Rising 9th to 12th grade (Junior PYNtern rising 9th to 10th; Senior PYNtern rising 11th to 12th)
name: PYNtern Program
what_you_do: Paid work-based learning: classroom professional skills training, mentoring, career coaching and, for rising juniors and seniors, about 100 hours at a paid worksite in the city.
who_can_apply: Young people ages 14 to 18, primarily rising 9th to 12th graders. The page does not state a residency rule.
pay_detail: Up to $1,500 for a 6 to 8 week experience, depending on hours and milestones
duration: 6 to 8 weeks per cohort (page also says experiences last 6 to 12 weeks)
deadline_text: Summer cohort applications open early March; Fall/Winter cohort open early August; Winter/Spring cohort open in November. Page says Now Recruiting for Summer + Fall 2026.
how_to_apply: Use Apply Now or the interest form on the page (name, contact, current grade, cohort, three career fields). Phone 267-502-3800 or info@pyninc.org.
notes: About 400 internship slots a year across cohorts. The city's large summer jobs program is C2L-PHL, a separate application.
